mapper.sql: GROUP_ID, GROUP_NAME, GROUP_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, active(IS_ACTIVE) as is_active, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_AT, CREATED_AT, EDITOR_USER_ID
mapper.select: SELECT g.group_id, g.group_name, common(g.group_type) as group_type, g.description, active(g.is_active) as is_active, COUNT(gm.user_id) AS member_count -- 추가 FROM groups g LEFT JOIN group_members gm ON g.group_id = gm.group_id AND gm.is_active = 'O1' -- 활성 멤버만 집계 GROUP BY g.group_id, g.group_name, common(g.group_type), g.description, active(g.is_active) ORDER BY g.group_id desc

SELECT g.group_id, g.group_name, active(g.is_active) as is_active, g.group_type, g.description,
-- 멤버 정보 m.group_member_id, m.user_id, r.role_name, r.role_id, u.user_name,
-- 대표 직군 그룹명 pg.group_name AS primary_group_name
FROM groups g LEFT JOIN group_members m ON g.group_id = m.group_id AND m.is_active='O1' LEFT JOIN users u ON m.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN roles r ON m.role_id = r.role_id -- 해당 유저의 대표 직군(is_primary='Y') 정보 찾기 LEFT JOIN group_members pm ON m.user_id = pm.user_id AND pm.is_primary = 'Y' LEFT JOIN groups pg ON pm.group_id = pg.group_id
WHERE g.group_id = #{groupId}
SELECT group_id,group_name,description,active(is_active) FROM groups WHERE group_type='C1' AND is_active='O1'
SELECT count(*) FROM groups WHERE upper(group_name) = upper(#{id})
mapper.insert:
select groups_seq.NEXTVAL from dual
INSERT INTO groups(group_id,group_name,group_type,description,created_by) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{groupName},#{groupType},#{description},#{createdBy})
mapper.select:
SELECT al.activity_log_id AS activityLogId, al.target_type AS targetType, al.target_id AS targetId, fn_get_action_name(al.action_type) AS actionType, al.actor_user_id AS actorUserId, u.user_name AS actorName, al.before_value AS beforeValue, al.after_value AS afterValue, al.created_at AS createdAt FROM activity_logs al LEFT JOIN users u ON al.actor_user_id = u.user_id WHERE -- 1. 그룹 자체(groups)의 변경 로그 가져오기 (al.target_type = 'groups' AND al.target_id = TO_CHAR(#{groupId}))
OR
-- 2. 해당 그룹에 속한 구성원(group_members)의 변경 로그 가져오기 (al.target_type = 'group_members' AND al.target_id IN ( SELECT TO_CHAR(group_member_id) FROM group_members WHERE group_id = #{groupId} )) ORDER BY al.created_at DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE groups
group_name = #{groupName},
is_active = #{isActive},
description = #{description},
editor_user_id = #{editorUserId},
updated_at = SYSDATE
WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.select: SELECT group_member_id AS groupMemberId, user_id AS userId, role_id AS roleId FROM group_members WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.update: UPDATE group_members SET role_id = #{roleId}, editor_user_id = #{editorUserId}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM group_members WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId}
